app_fee.value: Doctoral applications carry a CHF 100 application fee, paid online by card before the application can be submitted; it is not refunded.
app_fee.quote: An application fee of CHF 100 is due when you submit an application for doctoral studies

also.quote: At present the application fee amounts to CHF 100
